metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Log (v1.3)
metadata.subtitle: RTT • Measures • Paradox • Consent • Collapse • Lineage
metadata.description: Defines the authoritative chronological log for FFT AI Edition v1.3 sessions.

status_line: Session log MUST reflect authoritative state, RTT transitions, measures, paradox, consent, substrate, lineage, and collapse.

field_definitions.paradox_events: List of typed paradox events or empty list.
field_definitions.collapse_state: null unless RTT12; MUST be 'collapsed' at RTT12.
field_definitions.validation: Outcome of validation checks for this step.

measure_rules: All measures MUST be numeric in [0,1].
Every threshold MUST cite a measure ID.
paradox_rules: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.
rtt_rules: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
